description: This file defines the PresignUrlMiddleware class used internally in the AWS SDK for PHP to add presigned URLs to service operations that require such URLs. It manages middleware behavior for presigning requests, creating presigned URLs with appropriate endpoint resolution and signature.

classes.name: PresignUrlMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that adds presigned URLs to AWS service commands requiring such URLs, handling endpoint resolution and request signing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with options, endpoint provider, AWS client, and next handler.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method returning a callable that, when invoked, creates an instance of PresignUrlMiddleware.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invoker method that checks if the command needs a presigned URL and generates it if necessary.

methods.name: createPresignedUrl
methods.description: Creates a presigned URL for the given command using the AWS SDK's signing process.
